TS024 split-compound-assert

A compound assertion splits into one assertion per condition, so a failure reports which half broke.

languages: go javascript odin python rust typescript zig
severity: warning
default: on
group: stable

TigerStyle: "Split compound assertions: prefer `assert(a); assert(b);` over `assert(a and b);`. The former is simpler to read, and provides more precise information if the condition fails."
